name: dataverse-ui
description: Build tooling for the DataVerse FastAPI/HTMX UI (Tailwind CSS + vendored browser libs).

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p app/static/js/vendor && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js app/static/js/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js app/static/js/vendor/alpine.min.js
scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css
